facts.name: Alicia R. Washington
facts.assignment: Division52 — Felony Criminal; profile also identifies Administrative Judge for Putnam County.

contact.contact_note: Procedure names assistant Teresa E. Blaha; profile Teresa Blaha. Orders use division52 mailbox, ordinary communications use tblaha mailbox.

procedure_checklist.chambers_communications: Email JA with case number/name/subject and copy all parties.
procedure_checklist.hearing_scheduling: Request by JA email; send filed notice to confirm time and notify JA of cancellation.
procedure_checklist.proposed_orders: Email Word orders to division52@circuit7.org, stating agreement to form, within three days after hearing.
procedure_checklist.courtesy_copies: Email/mail/hand delivery; over25pages requires paper; ordinarily at least three business days before evidentiary proceeding.
procedure_checklist.conferral: Copy parties on communications and state agreement to proposed-order form; no criminal-motion conferral analysis.
procedure_checklist.motion_submissions: Specialized criminal-motion requirements not reviewed; official procedure document retained.

official_procedure_links.text: Admission of Violation of Probation/Community Control

facts.review_scope: Nine-page general procedure PDF collected; sectionsA–E reviewed only for basic office operations. Plea/violation forms and out-of-county plea requirements retained as official links, not separately collected or substantively reviewed. No criminal trial/merits analysis.
facts.summary: Felony criminal and county administrative assignment; basic scheduling/communications through JA, Word orders through division mailbox.
gaps: No separate direct judge email or JA-only phone published in checked sources.
